acceptanceCriteria: The failing tests are reproduced under load (for example -count and -cpu stress) and named.
Each is fixed or given a bounded, documented wait, with a stress run that passes.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. During the V1-0191 affected-test run on 2026-09-24, `benchmarks/runner` and `internal/behaviorfalsify` each failed once while the host was loaded, then passed three times when run alone. Neither package was in that change. The failing test names and output were not retained.
title: tests: benchmarks/runner and internal/behaviorfalsify each failed once under load, then passed alone
